cases.name: codex plugin manifest routes to codex surface
cases.description: Codex package manifest must load the package wrapper skills and hooks instead of the root Claude skill surface.

cases.name: codex marketplace points at package root
cases.description: The single-plugin Codex marketplace entry must install the package root, not the repository root.

cases.name: codex wrappers preserve naming side-effect contract
cases.description: Codex compatibility must preserve ha-apply-naming as a manual dry-run-first workflow.

cases.name: codex resolver remains infrastructure
cases.description: Codex should not implicitly invoke the infrastructure resolver skill.

cases.name: codex hooks do not require bash
cases.description: Codex hooks should use Python wrappers so Windows users do not need bash on PATH.

cases.name: codex env guard covers powershell env dumps
cases.description: Codex env guard must block common PowerShell environment-dump commands.

cases.name: codex package exposes a single skill tree
cases.description: The Codex package must contain exactly one SKILL.md tree so Codex Desktop does not list duplicate Home Assistant skills.
